marks_structure.extra_time_note: Koi extra time nahi milta. 3:15 ke baad answer sheet jama karni hoti hai.

paper_overview.sets_note: UP Board typically 4 sets: A, B, C, D. Questions same, sirf order alag hota hai.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi mein hi likhna hoga. English words ka use allowed hai jaise MCQ options ya technical terms mein.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Har section ke andar internal choice (athwa) hoti hai. Lekin har question ka ek part attempt karna zaroori hai.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: NCERT ki kitabein padna zaroori hai lekin sirf NCERT se UP Board ka paper clear karna mushkil hai. Sample papers aur previous year questions bhi zaroori hain.

question_types_in_exam.summary: UP Board Hindi paper has 4 khands: अ MCQ (16), ब Laghu 2-mark (14), स Short 3-mark (15), द Long/Nibandh (35). Total 80 theory + 20 IA = 100.

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf (अ), (ब), (स), (द) mein se ek likhna hota hai. Theory likhne ki zaroorat nahi.
types.mostly_from: Apathit Gadyansh; Rikat Sthan (Vyakaran, Alankaar); Charitra Chitran; Apathit Padyansh; Pathyapustak ke paaton se

types.how_to_attempt: Ek paragraph mein seedha answer. Heading nahi chahiye. 2-3 points 40 shabdon mein.
Sandarbh (1-2 lines) + Prasang (1-2 lines) + Vyakhya/Bhav (baaki). Ya: Definition + Explanation + Example.
types.notes: Khand-स ke kuch questions mein ATHWA (or) hota hai. Dono mein se ek choose karo.

types.how_to_attempt: Vyakhya ke liye: Sandarbh + Prasang + Shabd arth + Vistar se Vyakhya + Vishesh. Nibandh ke liye: Heading + Intro + Body + Conclusion.

paper_pattern.note: Paper mein 4 khand hain: Khand-अ, Khand-ब, Khand-स, Khand-द. Kuch sections mein internal choice hoti hai.
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Har section ke andar internal choice (athwa) hoti hai. Lekin har question ka ek part attempt karna zaroori hai.

sections.name: Khand-अ — Bahuvayanatmak Prashna (MCQ)
sections.breakdown: Khand-अ mein 16x1=16 marks ke MCQ questions hote hain. Negative marking nahi. Sirf option likhna hota hai.

sections.name: Khand-ब — Laghu Uttaratmak Prashna (Short Answer)
sections.breakdown: Khand-ब ke questions 40 shabdon tak ke hote hain. Zyada likhna time waste karta hai.

sections.name: Khand-स — Short Answer — 60 to 80 shabdon mein
sections.breakdown: Khand-स mein 10 prashna hain (Q10 se Q14), har ek 3 marks ka. Internal choice (athwa) hoti hai kuch questions mein.

topics.topic_name: Bhasha, Vyakaran evam Lipi ka Parichay

topics.tip: Alankaar ki definition + udaharan likhna zaroori. Sirf naam likhne se marks nahi milenge.

topics.note: Technical terms ke Hindi equivalents. Example: Software = Saftware ya Tantraang, Computer = Sanganak, Mobile = Charsakti.

topics.tip: Passage padhne ke baad pehle questions padho phir dobara passage padho; Answer passage mein hi hota hai — apni taraf se kuch mat jodo; 60-80 shabdon mein answer likhna kaafi hai; Heading likhna zaroorat nahi
Kavita ka saral arth apni bhasha mein likho; Alankaar poochha jata hai — metaphor/upma/anupras pehchhno; Kavya saundarya likho — ras, chand, alankaar

writing_section_formats.note: Rachnatmak Lekhan (18 marks) — Nibandh, Patra, Vigyapan, Samachar, etc. + Vyakhya formats + Charitra Chitran.

formats.structure: Sheersh + Bhumika + Mukhya Vishay (3-4 paragraphs) + Upsanhar
formats.tip: Nibandh mein sheersh ke baad 'Bhumika' heading se shuru karo. Upsanhar mein apna nirav likho. Quotes ya dohe add karo.
frequently_asked_topics: Vidhyarthi Jeevan mein Anushasan ki Mahatta

formats.structure: Praptakarta ka sthan + Tithi + Vishay + Sambodhan + Mukhya Bhag + Samapan + Naam/Hastaakshar
frequently_asked_topics: Principal ko TC ke liye aavedan
Nagar Nigam ko sadak sudhaar ke liye patra
Sampadak ko samajik samasya par patra
Police ko FIR ke liye aavedan

formats.structure: Headline + Body (product details) + Tagline + Contact info (optional)
formats.tip: Vigyapan chhota aur akarshak hona chahiye. Ek box ya border banana zaroor nahi lekin dikhne mein accha lagta hai.

formats.structure: Sandarbh: [Lekhak ka naam aur pathya ki kitaab ka naam] | Prasang: [Ye line kab aur kyun likhi gayi — context] | Vyakhya: [Line-by-line arth apni bhasha mein] | Vishesh: [Bhasha ki visheshata, shabd saundarya, alankar]
formats.tip: Sandarbh 0.5 + Prasang 0.5 + Vyakhya 2 + Vishesh 0.5 = approx 3.5 marks (5 marks wali vyakhya mein)

formats.structure: Sandarbh: [Kavi ka naam, kavya sangrah, kaal] | Prasang: [In panktiyoin ka context] | Vyakhya: [Har line ka saral arth] | Kavya Saundarya: [Alankaar, ras, chand, bhasha saundarya]
formats.tip: Kavya Saundarya mein sirf 1-2 alankaar likhna kaafi hota hai. Zyada list banana zaroorat nahi.

formats.structure: Prastuti: [Character ka seedha parichay — kaun hai, kahan ka hai] | Swabhav aur Gun: [2-3 main qualities with example from text] | Kamzoriyan / Sangharsh: [Agar koi ho] | Nirav / Mahatva: [Character ne kya seekhaya ya kaisi chhap chhhodi]
formats.tip: Charitra Chitran = kisi patra (character) ke baare mein essay style mein likhna

practical_paper.practical_exam_note: UP Board Hindi has no practical exam. 80 theory + 20 internal assessment = 100.

most_scoring_sections: Nibandh — agar topics ready hain to 5 marks pakke
most_difficult_sections: Apathit Gadyansh/Padyansh — kyunki ye pre-prepared nahi hota

exam_strategy.note: Pehle MCQ karo (easy marks). Phir Nibandh likhna start karo jab mind fresh ho. Apathit vyakhya akhir mein — zyada socha jaata hai.
tips: MCQ mein option clearly likho — wrong option se marks nahi katenge lekin blank chodne se 0 milte hain
Vyakhya mein Sandarbh-Prasang zaroor likho — 1-2 marks guaranteed hain
Nibandh mein sheersh + upsanhar ka structure rakho — flow acha lagta hai
Charitra Chitran mein text se example zaroor do
Patra mein Tithi aur Vishay line likhna mat bhoolna
Samachar ke 6 Kakar (Kya, Kab, Kahan, Kaun, Kyun, Kaise) yaad rakho
Alankaar mein sirf naam nahi — definition + udaharan likhna zaroori hai
Apathit mein apni taraf se kuch mat jodo — passage mein hi answer hota hai

time_allocation.note: 15 min — question numbers check karo, spelling dekho

targets.strategy: MCQ (16 marks) + Rikat Sthan (6 marks) + 2-3 questions Section B (6 marks) + Nibandh (4 marks) = 32+ marks
chapters_to_skip_safely: Ateet mein Dabe Paon (vitaan last chapter)

targets.strategy: MCQ max score + Short answers 4-5 clear karo + Nibandh + Vyakhya 1-2 try karo
Saare chapters + Vyakhya format bilkul sahi + Nibandh polished + Patra formal + Alankaar sab
targets.tip: Apathit Gadyansh/Padyansh mein pura time do — 12 marks wahan se aate hain aur koi preparation nahi chahiye, sirf practice.

internal_assessment.note: 20 marks internal assessment — school-level (project, assignment, class participation).

word_limit_excess: Word limit se thoda zyada likhne par marks nahi katenge. Lekin time wastage hogi.

pen_rules.note: Blue pen se main answer. Headings ko underline karo.
